name: crash-ai-crashsight
title: CrashAI CrashSight MCP
description: Scan CrashSight crashes by date/date range, keep version-filter duplicate rows, extract Redmine links, compare affected versions, and fetch single-crash stack context without dump payloads.
author: AIINWORK
capabilities: Daily or date-range CrashSight crash scanning without cross-version dedupe
Application version extraction for report tables
Redmine reference extraction with clickable issue links
Single-crash full stack context without dump payloads

setupFields.label: CrashSight Region
setupFields.description: cn uses crashsight.qq.com; sg uses crashsight.wetest.net.

setupFields.label: CrashSight localUserId
setupFields.description: CrashSight OpenAPI localUserId. Stored only in local MCP config.

setupFields.label: CrashSight OpenAPI Key
setupFields.description: CrashSight OpenAPI userOpenapiKey. Stored only in local MCP config.

setupFields.label: Branch Filters JSON
setupFields.description: JSON map from branch name to CrashSight version wildcard.

setupFields.label: Redmine Base URL
setupFields.description: Base URL used to format Redmine issue links in scan results.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Validate CrashSight configuration and appId mapping.

tools.name: scan_daily_crashes
tools.description: Scan CrashSight crashes by date/date range, platform, and version filters; keeps cross-version duplicate rows and returns total counts, application versions, and Redmine links.

tools.name: compare_issue_versions
tools.description: Compare one issue across version filters and judge continuation.

tools.name: get_single_crash_analysis_context
tools.description: Fetch full stack context for one crash without dump payloads.

tools.name: extract_redmine_refs
tools.description: Extract Redmine ids from tags, title, or message.
